title: Interaction to Next Paint (INP) Forensics
scenario: A mobile checkout page exhibits an INP score of 620ms (Poor > 500ms) caused by a monolithic event listener attached to the 'Add to Cart' button running un-debounced DOM mutations and third-party tracking scripts.
expected_diagnosis: High processing duration (480ms) attributed to synchronous analytics execution on main thread during user interaction.
expected_remediation: Yield to main thread using requestAnimationFrame or scheduler.yield()
Offload third-party tag firing to requestIdleCallback() or web worker
